question:
Choose the word that means the same as the given word.

Feat
solution:
The correct answer is "**Accomplishment.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **"Feat"** means an achievement that requires great courage, skill, or strength.(कमाल)

 
 
• Example: It was the first time such a feat had been accomplished.
 
 
 
• **"Accomplishment"** means something that has been achieved successfully.(उपलब्धि)
 
 
• Example: Reaching the end was itself an accomplishment.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, it can be concluded that "feat" and "accomplishment" are synonyms.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "Hallowed" means holy or revered.(पवित्र)
 
• "Handsy" means using the hands excessively or inappropriately.(हाथों का अत्यधिक या अनुचित उपयोग करना)
 
• "Obligation" means a duty or commitment to do something.(दायित्व)
